description: The RIDE Bikes FOLDING Series is purposefully designed for the small and mighty Ride. Pick the Folder when space is tight, but your life needs to stay in motion. You roll out with full power assist, then fold down for apartments, RVs, trains, and car trunks. It is simple to lift, stash, and charge anywhere, so your last mile becomes the best part of the trip.
